headline: Video; IEU-CEPA Signed, Which Issuer Sectors Will Benefit?
summary: The Indonesia-EU Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IEU-CEPA) has been signed. A CNBC Indonesia video examines which Indonesian listed sectors could benefit.
why: A trade agreement between Indonesia and the European Union can change tariffs and market access for exporters, which affects sector earnings and investment flows.
original_headline: Video; IEU-CEPA Ditandatangani, Emiten Sektor Apa Yang Diuntungkan?
